# card — Smart cards, PIV and OpenPGP tokens

[All groups](README.md)

## card read

Read a smart card or security key over PC/SC (needs a cgo build): lists readers, selects the PIV and OpenPGP applets and decodes their public objects (CHUID, certificates, discovery, Application Related Data) with the same checks as card.piv and card.openpgp. Never sends a PIN, so retry counters are untouched.

MCP tool: `card_read`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--reader` | string | Reader name or a substring of it; default the first reader. |
| `--applet` | string | Which applets to read. Default `all`. One of `all`, `piv`, `openpgp`. |
| `--list` | bool | Only list readers. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## card apdu

Decode ISO 7816-4 APDUs: a command (CLA/INS/P1/P2, Lc, data, Le; instruction and applet names; PIV/OpenPGP objects; PINs in VERIFY and friends are never shown) and/or a response (data as BER-TLV, status word meaning such as retries left or GET RESPONSE needed).

MCP tool: `card_apdu`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--command` | string | Command APDU, hex. |
| `--response` | string | Response APDU (data then SW1 SW2), hex. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## card piv

Decode a PIV data object (SP 800-73-4): CHUID with FASC-N, GUID, expiry and issuer signature; certificates (compressed or not) with full X.509 checks; the discovery object and PIN usage policy; key history. Input is the GET DATA response, hex or base64.

MCP tool: `card_piv`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--data` | string | The object (tag 53 wrapper or its contents), hex or base64. **Required.** CLI: `@path` reads a file, `-` reads stdin. |
| `--object` | string | Which object it is. Default `auto`. One of `auto`, `chuid`, `certificate`, `discovery`, `keyhistory`. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## card openpgp

Decode an OpenPGP card's Application Related Data (6E): version, manufacturer and serial, per-slot key algorithm, fingerprint and generation date, PIN retry counters (blocked PINs fail), and extended capabilities.

MCP tool: `card_openpgp`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--data` | string | Application Related Data (GET DATA 006E), hex or base64. **Required.** CLI: `@path` reads a file, `-` reads stdin. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## card openpgp_sign

Sign with an OpenPGP card's signature key (PSO: COMPUTE DIGITAL SIGNATURE) or authentication key (INTERNAL AUTHENTICATE), and check the signature with the slot's public key read from the card, that key against the stored fingerprint, and that the signature counter went up. Needs the user PIN (PW1).

MCP tool: `card_openpgp_sign`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--reader` | string | Reader name or part of it; default the first reader. |
| `--openpgp-pin` | string | The user PIN (PW1); else IDPDBG_OPENPGP_PIN or a no-echo prompt. Never tried with fewer than 2 attempts left, and never retried. Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_OPENPGP_PIN`, redacted in traces. |
| `--slot` | string | Which key. Default `signature`. One of `signature`, `authentication`. |
| `--message` | string | What to sign (default: a test string). CLI: `@path` reads a file, `-` reads stdin. |
| `--hash` | string | Hash of the message the card signs. Default `sha256`. One of `sha256`, `sha384`, `sha512`. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## card openpgp_decrypt

Decrypt with an OpenPGP card's decryption key (PSO: DECIPHER). Without a ciphertext it is a round trip: idpdbg encrypts a random value to the slot's public key (RSA PKCS #1 v1.5, or an ephemeral ECDH key) and checks the card's answer. With one it returns the plaintext (RSA) or the ECDH shared secret. Needs the user PIN (PW1).

MCP tool: `card_openpgp_decrypt`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--reader` | string | Reader name or part of it; default the first reader. |
| `--openpgp-pin` | string | The user PIN (PW1); else IDPDBG_OPENPGP_PIN or a no-echo prompt. Never tried with fewer than 2 attempts left, and never retried. Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_OPENPGP_PIN`, redacted in traces. |
| `--ciphertext` | string | RSA: the PKCS #1 v1.5 ciphertext; ECDH: the sender's ephemeral public key (hex or base64). Default: a round trip. CLI: `@path` reads a file, `-` reads stdin. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## card piv_generate

Generate a key pair in a PIV slot of a smart card or YubiKey (the private key never leaves the card) and return a CSR the card signs, for example with a UPN for smart card logon or PKINIT. Refuses a slot that already holds a certificate unless overwrite is set. Needs the management key and the PIN.

MCP tool: `card_piv_generate`. **Changes data at the remote system.**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--reader` | string | Reader name or part of it; default the first reader. |
| `--slot` | string | PIV slot: 9a, 9c, 9d, 9e or a retired slot 82-95. Default `9a`. |
| `--piv-pin` | string | PIV PIN; else IDPDBG_PIV_PIN or a no-echo prompt. Never tried with fewer than 2 attempts left, and never retried. Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_PIV_PIN`, redacted in traces. |
| `--management-key` | string | PIV management key in hex; else IDPDBG_MANAGEMENT_KEY, the card's PIN-protected key (ykman --protect), or a no-echo prompt. Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_MANAGEMENT_KEY`, redacted in traces. |
| `--algorithm` | string | Key type. Default `rsa2048`. One of `rsa2048`, `eccp256`, `eccp384`. |
| `--common-name` | string | Subject common name for the CSR. **Required.** |
| `--upn` | string | User principal name to put in the CSR's subject alternative name (Microsoft UPN otherName). |
| `--overwrite` | bool | Replace the key of a slot that already holds a certificate. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## card piv_import

Write a certificate into a PIV slot, after checking with a signature from the card that it belongs to the slot's key. Needs the PIN and the management key.

MCP tool: `card_piv_import`. **Changes data at the remote system.**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--reader` | string | Reader name or part of it; default the first reader. |
| `--slot` | string | PIV slot: 9a, 9c, 9d, 9e or a retired slot 82-95. Default `9a`. |
| `--piv-pin` | string | PIV PIN; else IDPDBG_PIV_PIN or a no-echo prompt. Never tried with fewer than 2 attempts left, and never retried. Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_PIV_PIN`, redacted in traces. |
| `--management-key` | string | PIV management key in hex; else IDPDBG_MANAGEMENT_KEY, the card's PIN-protected key (ykman --protect), or a no-echo prompt. Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_MANAGEMENT_KEY`, redacted in traces. |
| `--cert` | string | The certificate (PEM). **Required.** May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).
